decisions.reason: Close to the established offer and cheap to keep, so the option remains open while residual demand uncertainty persists.
The pegboard variant is a low-cost incremental extension that still holds option value without significant keeping costs.
It overlaps heavily with other quarter-pallet displays and after four years without signs of differentiated demand the option no longer justifies being kept.
The wooden pallet is a larger step from the core cardboard offer with higher keeping costs, and unresolved demand has tilted toward abandoning the option.
The media-specific niche has shown no evidence of value realization over time, so the option is abandoned as uncertainty has largely resolved.
